business_summary: Bhandari Hosiery Exports Limited operates as a textile and garment manufacturing company in India. The company offers knitted fabrics kora and dyed; and knitted hosiery garments, such as t-shirts, pullovers, sweatshirts, bermudas, polo shirts, track suits, pajamas, lowers, ladies knitted tops with embroidery and prints, etc. It also manufactures, processes, and trades in dyed and non-dyed fabrics. In addition, the company provides natural and synthetic circular knitted fabrics; open and tubular width fabrics; and specialised finishes comprising teflon, stain resistance, viscose, and lycra. Further, it offers tees and leggings for women; t-shirts, sweatshirts, pullovers, and polos for men; and t-shirts, sweatshirts, pullovers, polos, and joggers for kids. The company also exports its products. The company was incorporated in 1993 and is based in Ludhiana, India.
